text: Owner notice, Malaysia: workers at height near an unprotected edge at Pier P47 without fall protection. Stop work and report within 48 hours.
Subcontractor letter, Malaysia: Request for Variation Order for additional anchor bolts at roof trusses T4 to T9 and an extension of time of 10 days. Please respond within 14 days.
Owner notice, Malaysia: temporary access road at CH 12+400 damaged by haul trucks. Rectification within 72 hours and state responsibility per the responsibility matrix.
NCR-2026-084, Malaysia: concrete crack 0.4 mm on Pier P52 column with minor honeycomb. Corrective action within 7 days.
Owner letter, Malaysia: submit the method statement for heavy lifting, the lifting permit and CIDB registration of crane operators before lifting at Station S12, within 5 days.
马来西亚项目现场巡查：P47 墩高处作业无防护，工人未系安全带，作业班组需重新交底，24 小时内整改。
Supplier notice, Malaysia: the steel supplier advises a 6 week delivery delay on purchase order PO-7781 for station roof trusses.
Claim notice, Malaysia: contractor gives notice of a claim for delay caused by late access to the station site; entitlement and extension of time to follow.
Owner instruction, Malaysia: earthwork encroachment at interface zone CH 15+200; coordinate the boundary with the station package within 24 hours.
Commissioning note, Malaysia: AHU-01 at Station ST04 failed the functional test; punch list items remain before system readiness and handover.
Variation request, Malaysia: additional 48 nos M20 anchor bolts at RM 85 per no, total RM 4,080, under site instruction SI-2026-051. Respond within 14 days.
Owner notice, Malaysia: crane operator at Station S12 found without a valid inspection certificate for the mobile crane; stop lifting immediately.
